pages.html:
Description

The Admin Backpack Cube is a Backpack Cube, meaning it gives the user more inventory space once equipped. This cube, alongside all other Backpack Cubes, will be equipped permanently for the world.

Uses

Once equipped, the user will have unlimited inventory space, which can be accessed by opening the Roblox inventory. This makes the Admin Backpack Cube the best Backpack Cube in the game.

Unfortunately, the item is a Sandbox Exclusive, due to its over-powered nature.

Obtaining

The only way to obtain the Admin Backpack Cube, is through the Sandbox Panel, seeing how the cube is a Sandbox exclusive. It is located under the, "Give Item" tab.

Tier

The Admin Backpack Cube has a cube tier of 9,999.

pages.html:
Description

The AdminCMB is a one-to-one copy of the old Command Block texture from Minecraft. Due to the cube's origin, it would be reasonable to assume the "CMB" stands for "Command Block."

Uses

When the AdminCMB is equipped, the player will heal from attacks rather than taking damage. The amount of health the AdminCMB heals is controlled by how much damage was dealt to the player, with weaker attacks healing 2 Million HP, while some Bosses can heal 24 Million HP. This makes this cube the most powerful healing item in the game. The player can still take damage after falling off the map, meaning it is possible to die with the AdminCMB equipped.

The AdminCMB has a second use, being teleportation. By simply placing your cursor on the spot you want to warp to, then pressing "Z", you will be teleported to that exact location instantly.

Unfortunately, the item is a Sandbox Exclusive, due to its over-powered nature.

Note that the cube will only work when equipped, not held.

Obtaining

The only way to obtain the AdminCMB, is through the Sandbox Panel, seeing how the cube is a Sandbox exclusive. It is located under the, "Give Item" tab.

Tier

The AdminCMB has a cube tier of 7.

pages.html:
Introduction

Bosses are the main objective in the game to kill all the bosses with each boss getting progressively harder which is indicated by how many stars it has on the map. Each boss has the same spawn point in every world.

Cube Destroyer

Cube Destroyer is the first boss players should encounter, it being the easiest boss in Cubination, being the boss players face in the tutorial. They have a difficulty of 0.5 stars.

Cube Destroyer has 2,100 health points, being the least of all bosses, and uses mainly sharp and blunt attacks to defeat opponents. a simple guide to beat him because he is a slow attacker is to move backwards and frontwards to attack him

Abilities

Name Description
Slash Cube Destroyer swings his sword.
Deals 25 Sharp Damage.
Cube Smash Cube Destroyer's blue arm glows, before he raises his sword and smashes it into the ground, creating a trail of fake cubes infront of him.
Deals 45+ Dmg if hit directly.
Cube Stomp Cube Destroyer raises his cyan leg which glows before stomping the ground, causing massive knockback if the player is near and launching fake cubes all around him.
Cube Rain Cube Destroyer's torso glows, causing several fake cubes to rain down around him.
Fake Cubes After Cube Destroyer uses Cube Smash / Cube Stomp / Cube Rain he generates small cubes on the ground which deal 5 Damage upon contact with an unarmored player.
Heal Cube Destroyer's green arm glows and heals him for 100 HP.
Swiftness Cube Destroyer's magenta leg glows, causing him to move faster for 15 seconds.


Drops

Main Drop: Multi Cube

Other Drops: (6 random) Color Cubes, (9) Spikes

Gems: All players in the server are given 3 Gems for completing this boss fight.

Music

The song played while fighting Cube Destroyer is known as Demolition D.

revival requirments

to revive the boss you will need 1 White Cube 1 Yellow Cube 1 Cyan Cube 1 Spiked Cube and 1 Sacrificial cube to start

Raider Brute

Raider Brute is the second boss players should fight in Cubination, according to their 1-star difficulty.

Raider Brute has 3,325 health points, and they use sharp attacks.

Raider Brute spawning with tent what has 2,000 heath points. Minions appear in it that have 100 health points and have either a sword or a club. Also a heavy hitter so he is slow as you just need to go backwards when he attacks and frontwards to attack him pretty easy as for minions use throwable cubes to clear them

Abilities

Name Description
Swing Raider Brute swings his sword. Deals 90 Sharp Damage.
Backup Raider Brute summons 4 raiders (spearmen or swordsmen).

Drops

Main Drop: Iron Greatsword

Other Drop: (2) fabric cube (1) steel

Gems: All players in the server are given 5 Gem for completing this boss fight.

Music

The song played while fighting Raider Brute is known as Destruction Instruction (b)

Cyber Raider

Cyber Raider is the third boss players should fight in Cubination, having a 1.5-star difficulty. They have 4,550 health points, and their typing is Sharp. Same thing for this one is that same motion but just harder as he is tanky i recommend water type of swords to kill them as i guess the weakness for him is that

Abilities

Name Description
Swing Cyber Raider swings their Club. Deals 70 Sharp Damage.
Backup Similarly to Raider Brute, Cyber Raider summons 4 minions, who wield cyber clubs and are exclusively seen in this boss fight.

Drops

Main Drop: Great Cyber Club

Gems: All players in the server are given 6 Gems for completing this boss fight.

Music

The song played while fighting Cyber Raider is known as Hero Hour (Underscore) C

Pyro

Pyro is the fourth boss that players should fight in Cubination having a 2-star difficulty. Unlike the bosses in previous act, this one has multiple phases. They use Sharp attacks that inflict Fire upon the player, along with having a whopping 4,060 health points. Luckily for the player, you only need to use the same motion of movement to kill the boss. Also use water type attacks and when he stomps the ground move behind him to dodge it

Abilities

Name Description GIF
Phase 1
Slash Pyro swings his Greatsword, dealing 50 Fire + Sharp Damage and inflicts Fire 1 (7×5 Fire Damage over 4s). File:Pyrom1.gif
Slam Pyro slams his sword, creating fire spikes. Deals 70 Fire + Sharp and 7×5 Fire Damage over 5s. File:Pyroshards.gif
Phase 2 (40%)
Combustion At ~40% HP, Pyro ignites for 3–5s, then explodes, knocking players back and regenerating 30% HP. Explosion deals 144 Explosive + 18×8 Fire Damage over 8s. File:Pyroexplosion.gif
Fire Spikes Randomly summons fire spikes, increasing in number as his HP decreases. Spikes deal 10 Fire + 7×5 Fire Damage over 5s. File:Pyrospike.gif

Drops

Other Drop: Pyrolite

Gems: All players in the server are given 10 Gems for completing this boss fight.

Music

The song played while fighting Pyro is known as Chaos. Intense Hybrid Rock

Litho

Litho has a 2.5-star difficulty. They have an impressive 9,520 health points, along with using Blunt and Light typing. Just like Pyro, Litho has a second phase. Unlike all previous bosses, Litho takes 20% less damage. this is guy also easy as he needs time to actually hit his attacks. So use the same motion of backwards and forwards while also using blunt or sharp attacks to do real damage ☺️

Abilities

Phase 2 (40%)
Speed Though technically not an ability, it's still worth to mention that Litho becomes faster than a player using a speed coil when in their second phase. While not incredibly faster, it still makes it challenging to outrun Litho while in their second phase.
Swing+ Litho swings their hammer, now dealing 250 Blunt + Light Damage.
Slam+ Litho slams their hammer to the ground, dealing (a currently unknown amount of damage)
Stomp+ Litho stomps their foot on the ground, dealing 45 Damage and knocking the player back a lot. A. LOT.

pages.html: Chimera is one of the current endgame bosses. It will send multi-elemental waves at you - make sure to jump over or sidestep them. The main damage cycle is when it creates illusions of itself - you can only damage the boss (other than 1-2 damage at a time - it has huge resistances) by attacking the correct illusion. I don't think there are any visual tells as to which one is the "real" boss. The only way to tell which one is real is to run into them - you can push the illusions around, but you can't move the boss at all by running into it. I'm not sure if this is the developer's desired method for finding the real boss, but that's what worked for me.

pages.html:
Description

The Crystal is the heart of your main island and the server's control center, where you can customize your structures, allow other players on your server to build bridges, and upgrade your world with gems. All raiders and enemies (except bosses, until you fight them) that appear aim to destroy the Crystal. If they destroy the Crystal, you lose that save, but you can recover your Crystal to continue the game. The first restore is free, but the second and subsequent restores will cost Gems.

pages.html:
Description

Gems are permanent currency in Cubination, meaning you can earn gems in one server, then use them in a different one.

Uses

Gems have two uses. Buying Crystal Upgrades for that server only, or buying revives if the Crystal is destroyed.

Obtaining

The main way to obtain Gems is by killing Bosses, which reward Gems for every player in that server. The higher the boss's difficulty level is, the more Gems will be earned.

Another way to get Gems is by completing Achievements, which will reward a varying number of Gems.

Finaly, you can get Gems from entering Codes

pages.html:
Description

Loyalty cube - it is a cube that, when connected to another object, gives it the status of antivoid

He can be crafted or find in the black towers

Crafting method:

  1. Gold + white cube = gold cube
  2. Iron + white cube = iron cube
  3. Iron cube + gold cube = forge cube (make it 6 times)
  4. forge cube + steel cube = reinforced forge cube (make it 2 times)
  5. reinforced forge cube + gold cube = reinforced wealth cube
  6. reinforced forge cube + iron cube = reinforced plate cube
  7. forge cube + Iron cube = plate cube (make it 2 times)
  8. forge cube + gold cube = wealth cube (make it 2 times)
  9. plate cube + wealth cube = goldplate cube
  10. goldplate cube + cooled lava cube = enricher
  11. enricher + wealth cube = enricher cube
  12. enricher cube + healer cube = life cube
  13. black iron cube + life cube = heartbeat cube
  14. reinforced plate cube + reinforced plate cube = reinforced goldplate cube

pages.html:
Description

The spawn is the central island of Cubination, it is where every player spawns and is automatically unlocked upon creating a server.

This is where the 8 natural cubes spawn (Those being the red, green, blue, white, ice, rock, wood, and dirt cubes).

And additionally the 6 fixed natural structures: The Crystal, The Furnace, The Index, The Map, The Guardian Spawner, and the Researcher.

Upon creating a server a crate will spawn next to the Index, containing the following: Speed coil, Full Iron Armor, Pack cube, Forge cube, Armor cube.

Players spawn into the game facing east, toward Cube Destroyer.

The central island is 60² studs, broken up into squares. Each square is 4 studs and there are 15² squares.

The central island also leads to bridges, with a base of 40x8 studs, and the extendable part being 36 studs wide.

The trident is dropped by the guardian of the sea it is fairly basic, by the time you get it you’ll most likely have weapons that are as good if not better than it, but it has good range and stays out for a bit which lets you hit more enemies. Good for crowd control especially since it has a good amount of durability. Is it worth it? Depends, if you just have it by it self it’s kinda bad, but if you upgrade it to the fiery pitchfork then it will have more durability and also inflict a fire effect on whatever is hit by it, I would say that the trident is not worth it if you do not plan on upgrading it since even if you don’t die at all the boss fight takes very long. I would recommend it as more as a trophy instead of an actual weapon to use in battle
